scrutiny.test: T0 purpose: brew users, this Mac included, only move when the tap moves; today that takes five manual steps, two of which failed silently or transiently while cutting v0.3.0.
scrutiny.failureCase: A release that leaves the tap behind.

scrutiny.test: T1 owners: render.py owns filling and checking formulas; the workflow runs it rather than re-deriving url, sha256 or resources.
scrutiny.failureCase: A second formula writer in YAML.

scrutiny.test: T6 assumption checked: GITHUB_TOKEN cannot push to another repository, so a write deploy key scoped to the tap is the narrowest credential that works.
scrutiny.failureCase: A personal access token with access to every repo.

scrutiny.test: T11 class, every formula field that changes per release: url, sha256 and version via fill; prismis-cli's resources via the lock, already guarded by test_render's resources-match-lock test inside verify.sh, which make release runs before tagging.
scrutiny.failureCase: A release whose cli resources no longer match cli/uv.lock.

scrutiny.test: T13 two places: release values live only in the tap; the prismis copies return to templates.
scrutiny.failureCase: Two copies of the release url and sha256 that drift apart.

scrutiny.test: T20 walk: make release VERSION=0.3.1 bumps and relocks, verify passes, commit and tag push; the workflow checks versions and resources, fetches the tarball with retry, fills, pushes one tap commit; brew update on this Mac sees prismis 0.3.1 and brew upgrade installs it.
scrutiny.failureCase: A step that needs a human between tag and tap.

decisions.question: Automate tag-to-tap releases before switching this Mac to brew, or switch now with manual releases?
